_what: Where the Calendar screen (shared-calendar-screen.tsx, read through calendar-owners.ts) reads the person's calendar now that the Worker's /work/api/calendar routes are retired. Events: every account `accounts_tool` lists for `accounts_toolkit` whose status is `working_status`, each read by `events_tool` with `provider` over the range shown, at most `most_events` per account; an account whose read fails stays listed with its words. Tasks: no owner of a person's own timed tasks is named yet (a shared tool names no person's database), so the task list answers empty. Reading only: nothing here writes.
_mail: Mail accounts: every account `accounts_tool` lists for `mail_toolkit` whose status is `working_status`, each one a mail account on `mail_provider` (a row of tools/read-and-write-mail/read-data/mail-providers.json). Its mail tools take the account's connection id with the user id Composio asks for (`connection.user_id`).
